pages.text: Footwork adds a combat mobility system — dodging, strafing, and positional combat mechanics that reward active movement in fights.$(br2)$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Footwork is available from $(t1)T1$() and changes how every combat encounter feels. Dodge rolling costs stamina and has a cooldown — positioning and timing matter.$(br2)$(bold)Class synergy:$() $(thing)Ranger$() and $(thing)Samurai$() classes benefit most from Footwork's mobility options. $(thing)Berserker$() and $(thing)Vanguard$() can use it defensively to close gaps or disengage.$(br2)Craft the $(bold)Combatant's Companion$() for the full Footwork reference — dodge mechanics, stamina management, keybinds, and advanced movement techniques.
